title: Production guardrails & observability
summary: Module 5. Move from ad-hoc defenses to a measured guardrail layer. Run input/output scanners over a labeled probe set and report the numbers that matter — catch rate, false-positive rate, p50/p95 latency.
takeaway: A guardrail you can't measure isn't a control. Report catch rate, false positives, and latency.
design_rule: Scan input and output; benchmark against a labeled set; track the effectiveness dashboard.

steps.title: From seams to a real layer
